optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Agricultural Machinery Controllers
professionalSummary: Embedded software engineer with five years of experience on harvester controller teams, implementing functions per machine engineer specifications and company software standards. Proven track record of rigorous bench rig testing, field test diagnostics, and comprehensive release documentation. Strong collaboration with machine engineers and field test teams, ensuring clear responsibility boundaries and release approvals.
experienceHighlights: Implemented controller functions against specifications under the team’s software standard for five years.
Bench rig tested each function with attached test records and supported two harvest seasons of field testing with diagnostic logs.
Managed software review process, obtaining release approval from the controller software lead and recording approvals in release records.
Coordinated function changes with machine engineers via change logs, documenting proposed and received changes.
Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each release note directed to the field test team.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Two change records with rig test records and release approvals; one season’s diagnostics summary; one release note with limitation section, all linked to software repository references for verification.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample evidence establish the candidate’s experience and responsibilities directly related to the role requirements; no evidence is provided regarding export‑control paperwork or nationality impact on hiring decisions.

role.roleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Agricultural Machinery Controllers

evidence.text: Embedded software engineer on the harvester controller team of an agricultural machinery maker for five years, implementing controller functions against the machine engineers' function specifications under the team's software standard.
Tested each function on the bench rig with the rig test records attached to the change, and supported the field test programme for two harvest seasons with diagnostics from the controller logs.
Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the controller software lead's, recorded in the release record.
Coordinated function changes with the machine engineers through the function change log, recording which changes I proposed and which came from the machine engineers.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each release note for the field test team.
